title: pull-request report
description: What one stage of the pull-request loop (#3183) planned or applied: the members a change reaches, the digest the gate binds, where the approval stands and how the stage ended. Written by `chant components pr-plan` (pr-plan.json) and `chant components pr-apply` (pr-apply.json), and built by prReport in @intentius/chant/components/pr-run. The pull-request note is rendered from it by renderPrNote in @intentius/chant/pr-loop. Version 1 of the workspace read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

stage.description: plan: on the pull request. record (#4168, chant 0.124.33 and newer): on merge, the default; it plans the merged commit and writes the merge record, applying nothing. apply: on merge with --apply-on-merge, or (#4301, chant 0.124.42 and newer) at an open pull request's head with --before-merge, when beforeMerge is set.

pr.description: The pull or merge request number. null when an apply found no pull request that merged its commit.

member.description: The workspace member whose pipeline ran the stage. Absent outside a workspace member.

base.description: The commit the change is measured from: the merge base of the given base and head.

op.description: The gate's op, pr-<number>, or pr-<number>-<member> for a workspace member's pipeline. Its ledger is _gates/<op>.jsonl on chant/lifecycle. pr-unknown when no pull request was found.

gate.description: The gate the apply waits on, pr-apply unless the pipeline names another.

digest.description: The change-set digest of what this stage planned: computePlanDigest("change-set", ...) over every member's { member, planDigest }. What the gate binds.

status.description: planned: every member planned (plan stage). recorded (#4168, chant 0.124.33 and newer): every member planned on the merged commit and the merge record was written (record stage); approval says whether the plan is the approved one, and nothing applied. plan-failed: a member failed to plan, so nothing can apply. nothing: no component deploys what the change touches. applied: every member applied. failed: a member failed to apply and its dependents did not run. wave-applied (#4003, chant 0.124.32 and newer): with --wave-gate and --wave, the wave applied and a later wave is still to run. refused: nothing applied, see refusal. waiting (#3999): the approved plans applied except members held back after an upstream applied, which wait on an approval of the plan the last of rounds made.

refusal.description: Why an apply refused. plan-changed: an approval stands for another digest, so the plan changed after review. author-approved (#4000): under --require-review, an approval names the pull request's author or an author or committer of one of its commits. With --wave-gate (#4003, chant 0.124.32 and newer): wave-not-approved, a wave's new plan is not covered by the approved one and no approval of its gate stands for it; wave-plan-changed, an approval of its gate stands for another digest; earlier-wave, an earlier wave has work left or no record says it applied. The waves that applied before a wave refused stay applied; waves says which. locked (#4293, chant 0.124.41 and newer): under ci.locks, another open pull request holds a lock on a target the apply reaches, and nothing applied. With ci.policy (#4294, chant 0.124.41 and newer): policy-denied, the policy at base denied the plan and no override counts; policy-error, the policy could not be run or gave no readable answer. With pr-apply --before-merge (#4301, chant 0.124.42 and newer): requires-unmet, the pull request is not approved, mergeable, undiverged or green, and beforeMerge says which; before-merge-off, the declaration at base does not set ci.workflow to apply-before-merge for the member. Nothing applied.

message.description: The refusal or failure as printed.

resumed.description: Apply stage with --resume (#3464): an earlier attempt at the approved set failed partway. This run applied the rest under the same approval.

applied.description: Components the earlier attempt applied, which this run did not run again.

deployedOutputs.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4104, written by chant 0.124.30 and newer. Per dependency a member was planned against, the names of the outputs read from the deployed estate through its capability's outputs, sorted. A dependency outside the change is listed here too, and one whose stack is not deployed yet lists []. Outputs given with --seed-outputs, or carried from an earlier attempt's record, are not listed. Absent when no dependency was read, and on a resumed apply.

waveGate.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4003, written by chant 0.124.32 and newer. pr-apply --wave-gate <name>: the apply runs a wave at a time, each planned after the one before it applied, and wave k waits on <name>-wave-<k> under op when its plan moved. Absent without it.

waves.description: With waveGate: each wave reached so far, in order, with the approval it applied or waits under.

components.description: The components planned in it on the run that reached it.

approval.description: pull-request: the approved change set covers the wave's plan, and it applies under the pull request's approval (gate and digest are the report's). wave: its plan moved, and it needs an approval of its own gate for its new plan.

gate.description: The gate it applied or waits under: the report's gate, or <waveGate>-wave-<k>.

digest.description: The digest that gate binds: the report's digest, or the change-set digest of the wave's new plan.

approved.description: Waiting: an approval of the wave's gate stands for this other digest.

moved.description: Why the approved change set does not cover the wave's plan, one line per member.

overdue.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4289, written by chant 0.124.41 and newer. Plan stage: the scheduled watch and reconcile Ops whose cron has fired at least twice since their job last ran, or since their pipeline file was added when no run is on record. Absent when none is overdue or the forge was not asked.

since.description: The job's last run, or the pipeline file's first commit when neverRan, ISO 8601.

message.description: The warning as the plan note prints it.

plannedOutputs.description: Added within contract version 1 by #3999, written by chant 0.124.32 and newer. Per dependency in the change that a member was planned against, the names of the outputs its plan knows, sorted. An output a member reads that is not listed is known only after apply, and the member lists it under unknownInputs. Absent when no member read one.

rounds.description: Added within contract version 1 by #3999. Apply stage: the rounds planned after an upstream applied, in order. A member whose plan read an upstream output that applied as another value, or was known only after apply, is held back and planned again against the outputs the apply left; each round has its own gate and digest. Absent when nothing was held.

gate.description: The gate the round waits on: <gate>-round-<round>.

digest.description: The change-set digest of what the round planned. What its gate binds.

components.description: The components planned again, in apply order.

approval.description: Where the approval stands for digest, as the top-level approval.

message.description: With waiting: why an approval that stands does not count under --require-review.

changeSet.description: The change-set document the round planned. Its digest equals digest.

status.description: approved: an approval stands for digest. changed: one stands for another digest. pending: none stands.

approvedBy.description: Who approved digest, as the approval names them (github:<login>, gitlab:<login>, <forge>@<host>:<login>, or a signer).

approved.description: With changed: the digest that was approved.

selection.description: Component names. The fan-out derivation the change gives (#2417).

changed.description: Components deploying a unit the change touched, in dependency order.

dependents.description: Components selected because they depend on a changed one, in dependency order.

unclaimed.description: Units the change touched that no component deploys.

indeterminate.description: Components a source diff cannot judge that the walk did not reach.

waves.description: The selected components in parallel-safe waves, in apply order.

members.description: One entry per change-set member, sorted by member.

member.description: The member's name in the change set: the root, for a terraform-family step.

planDigest.description: What a gate on this member alone binds. null when it failed to plan.

status.description: waiting (#3999): held back because its plan read an upstream output that applied as another value, or was known only after apply; it waits on an approval of its plan in rounds.

inputsMoved.description: Apply stage: components this one depends on whose outputs changed when they applied. It applied the plan it was approved with; the next run plans it against the new values. Not written by chant 0.124.32 and newer, which holds such a member back instead (held, round).

unknownInputs.description: #3999: the upstream outputs its plan read that the change's plans could not say, as <component>.<output>, sorted. Known only after that upstream applies; the approval does not cover what this member does with them.

buildInputs.description: #3999: the published artifact identities its plan read from a build in the same change, as <component>.publish.<field>, sorted. Known only after the build runs and never approved again: the build's provenance binds them, so the member applies without a later round.

round.description: Apply stage (#3999): the round whose plan it applied or waits on, when not the first. planDigest and counts are that round's.

held.description: Apply stage (#3999): why the first round's plan did not apply.

changeSet.description: The change-set document over every member (change-set.schema.json). Its digest equals digest.

hooks.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4288, written by chant 0.124.41 and newer. The stage hooks the job ran, in order, from ci.hooks in the workspace declaration at base. Absent when it ran none.

target.description: The component, for a perRun hook.

outcome.description: held: an onFailure approve hook failed, which the pull request's gate answers.

beforeMerge.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4301, written by chant 0.124.42 and newer. pr-apply --before-merge: the requires checks the forge answered before anything planned (ws-106). Absent on every other stage.

pending.description: The forge had not settled it when asked: a check still ran, or it had not worked out whether the pull request merges.

policy.description: Added within contract version 1 by #4294, written by chant 0.124.41 and newer. What ci.policy in the workspace declaration at base said about the change set. Absent when the base sets no policy, or the stage reached no plan to judge.

result.description: denied wins over held. error: the policy did not run or gave no readable answer, and nothing applies.

base.description: The commit the settings and the policy were read at.

rules.description: The ids of the rules that denied, sorted: what an override names.

holds.description: Rules that hold the plan for a person's approval of its digest.

override.description: The override on _gates/policy-override.jsonl that lets the denied plan through.

digest.description: The override digest: the op, the plan digest and the rules.

overrideCommand.description: While denied: the command that overrides the denial.
